channel.title: Joe Hartmann Finds
channel.description: Joe Hartmann Finds is a growing collection of Amazon affiliate finds, each with a short article and a link back to the Pinterest pin that inspired it.

item.title: Logitech MX Keys S Wireless Keyboard – Backlit Low-Profile Desk Keyboard
item.description: A closer look at the Logitech MX Keys S, a low-profile backlit wireless keyboard with smart illumination, multi-device pairing, and a laptop-like typing feel.

item.title: Breville Bambino Plus Espresso Machine – Compact Stainless Home Barista
item.description: A closer look at the Breville Bambino Plus, a compact stainless espresso machine with a 3-second ThermoJet heat-up, automatic microfoam, and a 54 mm portafilter.

item.title: Ember Temperature Control Smart Mug 2 – App-Controlled Heated Coffee Mug
item.description: A closer look at the Ember Mug 2 in 10 oz white, an app-controlled heated mug that holds a set temperature on a charging coaster or on its built-in battery.

item.title: Garmin Venu 3 Smartwatch – 45mm AMOLED Fitness Watch, 14-Day Battery
item.description: A closer look at the Garmin Venu 3, a 45 mm AMOLED GPS smartwatch with Body Battery energy monitoring, sleep coaching, and a built-in speaker and microphone for calls.

item.title: Anker Prime 240W Charging Station – 8-in-1 USB-C Desk Charger
item.description: A closer look at the Anker Prime 240W 8-in-1 charging station, a compact desk hub with four USB-C ports, two USB-A ports, two AC outlets, and up to 140W from a single USB-C port.

item.title: DJI Mini 4K Camera Drone – Under 249g 4K UHD with 3-Axis Gimbal
item.description: A closer look at the DJI Mini 4K, a foldable camera drone under 249 g with 4K UHD video, a 3-axis gimbal, and beginner-friendly flight tools such as Auto Return.

item.title: Logitech MX Master 4 Wireless Mouse – Ergonomic Haptic Productivity Mouse
item.description: A closer look at the Logitech MX Master 4, an ergonomic wireless mouse with haptic feedback, MagSpeed scrolling, an 8K DPI sensor, and multi-device pairing.

item.title: Braun Series 9 PRO+ Electric Shaver – Wet & Dry Foil Razor with SmartCare
item.description: A closer look at the Braun Series 9 PRO+ 9697cc, a Made-in-Germany wet-and-dry foil shaver with Pro SensoAdapt, a 6-in-1 SmartCare center, and a ProComfort head.

item.title: Kindle Paperwhite 16GB (2024) – 7-Inch Glare-Free E-Reader, Weeks of Battery
item.description: A closer look at the 2024 Kindle Paperwhite 16GB, a 7-inch glare-free e-reader with adjustable warm light, USB-C charging, and a waterproof design for travel and everyday reading.

item.title: Sony WH-1000XM6 Noise Cancelling Headphones – Flagship ANC for Work and Travel
item.description: A closer look at Sony’s WH-1000XM6 wireless headphones, with adaptive noise cancellation, a foldable design, and long battery life for work, commutes, and travel.

item.title: Logitech G PRO Racing Pedals with 100kg Load Cell Brake
item.description: A closer look at the Logitech G PRO Racing Pedals, a three-pedal sim racing set with a 100 kg load-cell brake, Hall-effect sensors, and adjustable pedal modules.

item.title: Fanatec Gran Turismo DD Pro Direct Drive Wheel, Base & Pedals
item.description: A closer look at the Fanatec Gran Turismo DD Pro, an officially licensed 5 Nm direct-drive sim racing kit for PS5, PS4, and PC, with a Polyphony-designed wheel and a two-pedal set.

item.title: MOZA R5 Direct Drive Racing Wheel Bundle for PC
item.description: A closer look at the MOZA R5 bundle, a PC sim racing kit with a 5.5 Nm direct-drive base, a quick-release ES steering wheel, SR-P Lite pedals, and a desk clamp.

item.title: Thrustmaster T300RS GT Force Feedback Racing Wheel & 3-Pedal Set
item.description: A closer look at the Thrustmaster T300RS GT, a belt-driven force-feedback wheel with a brushless motor, a three-pedal T3PA-GT set, and official PlayStation and Gran Turismo licensing.

item.title: Logitech G923 TRUEFORCE Racing Wheel & Pedals for PS5, PS4 & PC
item.description: A closer look at the Logitech G923 racing wheel and pedals, a PS5, PS4, and PC sim racing set with TRUEFORCE feedback, a progressive brake, and dual-clutch launch assist.

item.title: Butter-Soft Leggings – TikTok’s Everyday Comfort
item.description: CRZ YOGA Butterluxe 25-inch high-rise leggings use a soft, stretchy polyamide-Lycra fabric with gentle compression, made for yoga and lounge.

item.title: Oversized Knit Sweaters – Cozy TikTok Fall Favorite
item.description: PRETTYGARDEN’s oversized cable-knit crewneck sweater is a loose, long-sleeve acrylic pullover with balloon sleeves, meant for fall and winter layering.

item.title: Matching Two-Piece Sets – TikTok’s Easy Outfit Formula
item.description: A look at the PRETTYGARDEN two-piece lounge set: a long-sleeve crewneck top and high-waist drawstring joggers with side pockets, in a soft polyester-cotton blend.

item.title: Mini Belt Bag – The TikTok Hands-Free Essential
item.description: The Pander 1L nylon belt bag has a two-way zipper, three interior mesh pockets, and an adjustable strap so you can wear it as a belt bag, crossbody, or chest bag.

item.title: Flannel Shacket – TikTok’s Layering Must-Have
item.description: The CHICZONE plaid flannel shacket is an oversized, midi-length button-down shirt jacket with chest and side pockets, made of brushed polyester.

item.title: Pillow Slides – The Viral Cloud Comfort Shoes
item.description: Dirk’s unisex EVA cloud slides have a thick cushioned sole, a sunken footbed, and a waterproof slip-on design for indoor or casual outdoor wear.

item.title: Oversized Hoodies – Cozy TikTok Streetwear Essential
item.description: A closer look at the Trendy Queen oversized hoodie, a cotton-polyester fleece pullover with a relaxed drop-shoulder fit for everyday wear.

item.title: Cargo Pants – TikTok Utility Street Style
item.description: Dokotoo’s high-waist, wide-leg cargo pants with six pockets and a cotton-elastane stretch blend, made for everyday wear, travel, and weekends.

item.title: Soft Compression Tops – TikTok Skims-Style Layer
item.description: A look at TELALEO’s 4-pack of women’s long-sleeve compression shirts, a moisture-wicking base layer with four-way stretch.

item.title: Wide-Leg Pants – The TikTok Office-to-Casual Staple
item.description: A closer look at G4Free high-waist wide-leg pants, a stretch pull-on style with functional front pockets that can dress up or down.
